basic_details.job_title: Army Public School Bareilly Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Account Clerk, LDC and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Army Public School Bareilly wants three administrative staff on term basis: a Head Clerk, an Account Clerk and a Lower Division Clerk (LDC). The notice calls these tentative posts. The school describes itself as private and unaided (Pvt-Unaided), so these are not government posts. Candidates apply on the prescribed form from www.armypublicschoolbly.com and send it to the Principal, Army Public School, Bareilly, with a DD of Rs 250/-. The last date is 07 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Post Age Limit Head Clerk, Lower Division Clerk (LDC) Below 40 for fresh candidates and below 55 years for ESM | Age is counted as on 01 April 2026. The notice does not print an age limit for the Account Clerk post. The school's NOTE says candidates can find the educational qualifications and age criteria on www.armypublicschoolbly.com, or ask at the school office between 0900h and 1400h on working days. Check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: About APS Bareilly
content_sections.text: Army Public School Bareilly is a school in Bareilly. The notice describes it as private and unaided (Pvt-Unaided). The notice says the selection will follow the policies of the Army Welfare Education Society (AWES).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists three tentative posts on term basis. It does not give a number of vacancies for any post, so each post counts as one vacancy here. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice calls these requirements "Qualification Requisites (QR)". The age and experience of candidates will be counted as on 01 April 2026 , subject to verification of the applicable recruitment policy. Preferably an Ex-Serviceman of clerk category up to the age of 55 years. Experience: 5-10 years experience in Office Management and account handling as Head Clerk, with high proficiency in staff duties and drafting experience. Computer Savvy - MS Office, online works etc. Should not have any disciplinary case against him in the entire service or otherwise. Computer literate (MS Office, Tally etc.). Computer Savvy (12000 key depression per hour). Knowledge of relevant software applications like Tally, ERPs, PF, ESIC, TDS, GST etc. Experience: 5 years experience as a clerk or an accounts clerk in a reputed organization, preferably a school. Basic computer application course of Army, or Diploma in Computer Applications of not less than one year duration. Basic knowledge of accounting and accounting software. Age is counted as on 01 April 2026. The notice does not print an age limit for the Account Clerk post. The school's NOTE says candidates can find the educational qualifications and age criteria on www.armypublicschoolbly.com, or ask at the school office between 0900h and 1400h on working days. Check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies, 1 each for Head Clerk, Account Clerk and Lower Division Clerk (LDC). The notice lists the three posts without printing a number for each and calls them tentative posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 07 November 2026. Applications received after the due date will not be accepted in any case.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the APS Bareilly clerk posts?
faq.answer: Head Clerk needs to be a Minimum Graduate in case of civilian. Account Clerk needs a B. Com. or fifteen years of service as a clerk (for Ex-Servicemen). LDC needs to be a Graduate or have ten years service as a clerk in the Defence Services.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Head Clerk and LDC at APS Bareilly?
faq.answer: For both Head Clerk and LDC, fresh candidates must be below 40 and ESM must be below 55 years, counted as on 01 April 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What application fee does APS Bareilly charge?
faq.answer: The application must go with a DD of Rs 250/- in favour of "Army Public School Bareilly".

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed form from www.armypublicschoolbly.com. Send it with a DD of Rs 250/- to the Principal, Army Public School, Bareilly, by 07 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called. Selection has three stages: a Written Test, a Computer Competency Test and a Panel Interview, and it follows the policies of the Army Welfare Education Society (AWES).

faq.question: Q8. Are the APS Bareilly clerk posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, they are not permanent. The notice offers tentative posts on term basis. It also describes Army Public School Bareilly as a private unaided school.

faq.question: Q9. Are Ex-Servicemen preferred at APS Bareilly?
faq.answer: Yes, for Head Clerk. The notice says this post is preferably for an Ex-Serviceman of clerk category up to the age of 55 years. For Account Clerk, Ex-Servicemen can qualify with fifteen years of service as a clerk instead of a B. Com.
